feature: imitation strength (prepared; enabled only at a registered update boundary for B-v2v and R-v2v together)

commits.what: kl_targeted step mode + v2v_intent_bank_term switch + trained-subset intent metric; wired through prepare_intent/BANK_OPTIONS (B==R)
CPU tests + bind_runtime validates the new keys via the B/R helpers

imitation_step_mode.kl_targeted_rule: within each pass, if the accepted pass ends with KL (joint_kl vs the post-PPO snapshot, same measurement) below half the registered limit, the next pass doubles its step scale (cap 16x base lr) and its optimizer steps (cap 4x, minibatch 128//mult of the same fixed permutation); existing halving backtracking unchanged; the registered KL limit 0.045 is never exceeded
imitation_step_mode.enablement: registered flip of BANK_OPTIONS['imitation_step_mode'] (+ deployed runtime) at a registered update boundary; B and R move together (bind_runtime refuses any B/R mismatch; optional *_by_arm mapping accepted only when B == R == the key)
wiring: bank_imitation.run_separate(step_mode=..., falls back to the installed runtime value)

v2v_intent_bank_term.false_drops: the v2v_intent bank intent term is removed from the run_separate imitation loss (legacy run() unchanged)
wiring: bank_imitation.run_separate(intent_bank_term=..., falls back to the installed runtime value)

keys.intent_metric_honesty: exact_grade.exact_update reports the bank intent loss on the TRAINED subset (w>0, trainable pairs) as v2v_intent.before_trained/after_trained (bank_imitation.trainable) alongside the all-pairs before/after

tests.scope: CPU only (no SUMO, no GPU, no ssh/remote)

covers: fixed mode identical (default == explicit, no new report keys)
kl_targeted grows step scale when KL low and never exceeds the limit (mults 1..16 cap, steps 1..4 cap)
action error falls more than fixed on a synthetic bank
backtracking intact (halving on exceed, growth resumes after a low accept, lr restored)
refusal unchanged when the limit never fits (both modes)
intent metric on trained subset (exact_update before_trained/after_trained)
bank_term off removes the term (spy) and flags the report
B/R equality: BANK_OPTIONS pin, bind_runtime refusals, by-arm mapping rules, A refused
registered flip to kl_targeted binds+prepares+installs for B and R together
